summary: Opera Limited filed a Form 6-K on June 10, 2026, announcing a semi-annual cash dividend of $0.40 per share under its recurring dividend program. The dividend will be payable on or about July 14, 2026, to shareholders of record on July 7, 2026. Based on 89,552,967 shares outstanding, the aggregate dividend is approximately $35.8 million. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation. The filing does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation transaction.
